comment: Absolutely stunning place for sunsets! Much quieter than the main park entrance. Perfect for families!
Discovered this pin from Vicky's recommendation! Incredible view of Grapevine Lake. Great photo spot.
Great spot to sit and watch the sailboats. Kids loved playing near the water. Bring bug spray!
Breathtaking views of the Golden Gate Bridge and a very peaceful labyrinth walk. Best kept SF secret.
A bit windy, but absolutely worth the walk down. The stones are beautifully laid out.
The famous tree swing is back! You get a full panoramic view of the SF skyline. Pure magic.
